function.arguments: {"is_bug":true,"summary":"The reported matched-width contrast and bootstrap are not correctly matched/valid. Growth and decline are pooled across the whole time series, so shared time trends can create the contrast; furthermore the bootstrap samples blocks from `idx` (already filtered rows) but applies those positions as original row indices, mixing unrelated observations and invalidating its interval. Also `np.nan_to_num` makes unavailable lag values zero, although the common interval excludes those rows for the primary fit but sensitivity eval may have distinct masks. Use contiguous original-index moving blocks, and estimate the contrast conditional on width (and time), restricted to genuine support overlap; interpret forecast scores cautiously since expanding TimeSeriesSplit tests later regimes only."}
